body.name: validated Gaussian and objective interval oracle
body.construction: For a rational staffing interval \(I\subseteq[-G,G]\) and precision \(m\), complete squares on both sides of the moving kink and enclose \(\exp\), \(\operatorname{erf}\), and \(\Phi^{-1}\) by rational range-reduced series with signed remainder bounds. Choose rational \(R>|x^*|\), where \(x^*=0\) for \(\gamma\ge0\) and \(x^*=-\nu\gamma/d\) otherwise, and outward-round \(B_R=\sqrt{D/(2\pi q)}\{2q/[d(R-|x^*|)]\}\exp[-d(R-|x^*|)^2/(2q)]\) until both \(B_R\) and \((2q/d^2)B_R\) are at most \(2^{-(m+4)}\). These quantities enclose the omitted stationary probability and Poisson-energy tails. Split validated quadrature at \(\gamma\) on \([-R,R]\). Return \(\mathfrak O(I,m)=[\underline J(I,m),\overline J(I,m)]\) and \(L_J\in\mathbb Q_{>0}\) such that \(J(p,\eta)\in\mathfrak O(I,m)\) for every \(\eta\in I\) and \(\overline J-\underline J\le L_J\operatorname{diam}(I)+2^{-m}\); point intervals have width at most \(2^{-m}\).
